distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) records Sichuan and Fujian; 黄复生等 (2015) adds Hainan and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently reports Taiwan and broad China (SE, SW). The broad regional wording is retained as context only and does not generate new province records.

host_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984)/黄复生等 (2015) species-level and genus-level hosts are retained. Beaver & Liu (2010) specifically records Cinnamomum, Cryptomeria, Eugenia, Styrax and Wendlandia in Taiwan; these are added at genus level. The broad word 'polyphagous' remains contextual only.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytoplatypus mikado Blandford, 1893.
